existing_normalization_references.boundary: This package adds task-completeness research and links to canonical production records. A future integrator must reference these identifiers rather than introduce parallel ring, daily-counter, or Bones to Peaches actions.

global_rules.task_order: Tasks may be completed in any tier order.
global_rules.tier_claim: A tier claim requires every task in that tier and every preceding tier.
global_rules.boostability_default: Temporary boosts may satisfy a skill requirement unless the task explicitly says otherwise.
global_rules.proposed_task_transition: A successful task action adds only its durable lumbridge_draynor_diary_<tier>_<task> milestone. It does not infer combat victory, catch/mine/theft success, farming growth, minigame score, cape ownership, quest completion, charged-item state, or daily uses.

normalization_proposal.rule: Each noncanonical task becomes one proposed action that produces only a durable task milestone. Claim actions require every task milestone in their tier plus the preceding claimed tier. Existing Explorer's ring and Bones to Peaches actions remain canonical and are referenced, not duplicated.

actions.exception: Use existing action:complete-lumbridge-hard-bones-to-peaches-task for the hard Bones to Peaches task.

graph_nodes: existing Explorer's ring item and capability nodes
graph_edges: each verified skill, quest, location, item, spellbook, and access condition -> task action (requires)
each completed task action -> task milestone (produces)
all task milestones in a tier plus prior claimed tier -> tier claim action (requires)
tier claim action -> claimed-tier milestone and lamp entitlement (produces)
tier claim -> existing canonical Explorer's ring claim/capability data (references)
existing Mage Training Arena/Bones to Peaches node -> hard task action (requires)
state_boundaries: Exact daily ring restoration, alchemy, and cabbage-teleport counters are factual capabilities only; no action advances, resets, or assumes their counters.
Mage Training Arena point earning, room performance, rune expenditure, and current pizazz balances are not inferred. The fixed Bones to Peaches purchase threshold is a requirement, not a grant.
Combat victories, catches, mines, pickpockets, combination-rune success, farming growth and yield, minigame scores, and multi-step uninterrupted completion are player-confirmed results.

Quest completion, current all-quests status, Quest point cape ownership/equipment, current fairy-ring staff exemption, Slayer assignment, cape purchase, and charged-item state remain observed account state.
Lamp recipient selection is player input; lamp XP is not assigned to a skill by a tier claim.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Dorgesh-Kaan elite task
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: The current elite task is grappling a pylon on the Dorgesh-Kaan Agility Course. Older guides that say to pickpocket Movario are stale; that task was replaced on 10 July 2024.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Former diary-gated shortcuts
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Historical reward summaries list the Draynor narrow tunnel and Lumbridge swamp-to-desert grapple. Official Project Rebalance removed their achievement-diary requirements, so they are not current claim outputs in this package.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Bones to Peaches
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: The tablet does not complete the hard task. The spell purchase requires fixed pizazz thresholds, but collecting the points, supplying runes, and successful current unlock are not inferred from nominal access.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Quest cape elite task
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: Completion of all current quests, 65 Defence, a 99,000-coin cape purchase, ownership/equipment, and the emote are distinct conditions. A task model must never turn a quest prerequisite list into a completed Quest cape state.

conflicts_and_unknowns.subject: Official source coverage
conflicts_and_unknowns.detail: The current Wiki supplies live task and reward specifics. The official reward and shortcut posts are historical/change evidence only, not proof that unlisted current effects still apply.
